scope: Preview source dependency visual grammar and hooks for separately validated source conditional overlays
contracts: Existing source_dependency edges with syntaxOnly or legacy inspection endpoint evidence default to purple short dashes. Tensor edges, shape edges and visual drafts are not reclassified.
Visual defaults preserve user edge color, width and dash choices. Monochrome retains source patterns.
Only one existing studio legend contains source-value and conditional rows; no duplicate diagram legend.
Adapter presentationVersion 6 retains foldedPresentation and adds a bounded decision band only for source conditional inspection containers.
Source evidence, canonical IR, binding identity, roles and graph edge/node membership remain unchanged by source dependency rendering.
Control overlays are separately produced by source-controls.js. App hooks render cached geometry, refresh after committed graph tasks and crop exported detail overlays by source owner and target.
limitations: Standalone Chromium SVG sanitization was skipped because the sandbox prevents Chromium startup. Root handles real browser acceptance and final unified suite.
Condition overlay geometry, refresh caching and ACT coverage are validated separately by source_hierarchy.
Earlier previewGeneralization run encountered a stale AST fixture hash while another agent changed source_dependencies.py. Root regenerates fixtures before final full suite.
